_about: The M900 series: Ward-Beck console modules, almost all for the Renaissance radio console (MKI/MKII/MKIII, 1993-97; M920-M927 for the REN TV console). Code -> function, the consoles (job numbers) whose drawings show it, the drawing its front panel is drawn from (tools/panels.json holds the crop) and its other drawings (2026 paths). Console jobs draw a module under the job number (940238-04-003, 940444-03-006), and their OCR garbles codes (MIOINW = M901NW, MIOSNW = M905NW, M9O1CY = M901CY). tools/make_panels.py reads "drawings.layouts" as front-panel candidates. Built 2026-11-25|59 from the console folders, title blocks, OCR notes and the AutoCAD files.
